h1: Recreational Steel Buildings and Gyms in Wyoming, Utah & Idaho
answer: Brooks Steel Buildings supplies custom pre-engineered steel buildings for gyms, indoor sports, fitness centers, and community recreation. Wide clear spans and tall eaves give you open, column-free space, and every building is engineered for your site’s snow and wind loads.
intro_h2: Open Space for Play, Training, and Events
intro_p: Recreational buildings need wide open floors and high ceilings, and steel framing delivers both. We design the span, eave height, and openings around your sport or activity, then engineer the building for your site. Explore dimensions, rooflines, colors, and openings in our 3D designer before you call. Planning a school or church building? See our Schools and Gymnasiums page.

faq: What size recreational building do I need?

It depends on the activity. Start with the playing area your sport or activity needs, then add room for seating, entrances, storage, and circulation. Tell us your plans and we will help you choose a width, length, and eave height.
Can a steel building be used as a gym?
Yes. Steel framing allows the wide, column-free span and tall eaves that gyms need. Tell us the sports you will play so we can plan the width, length, and height around them.
How high can the eaves be for indoor sports?
Steel buildings can be designed with tall eaves to give you overhead clearance. The height you need depends on the sport, so tell us your activity and we will plan the building around it.
Do you supply overhead doors, windows, or flooring?

No. We design the building and its openings for the overhead doors and windows you choose, and they are installed by others. We supply commercial walk doors (man doors). Flooring and interior finishes are by others.
Yes. We supply insulation. Tell us how you will use the space and we will include the right options in your quote.
Do I need a permit for a recreational building?

Yes, in most places. Requirements vary by county or city and by how the building will be used. Check with your local building department. Your building is engineered for local codes, with plans prepared for permitting.
Can I add on to the building later?
Yes. Steel buildings can often be designed so bays or lean-tos can be added later. Let us know your plans so the design allows for it.
How long does it take to get a recreational building?
Our current turnaround is 8 to 10 weeks. Timelines can vary with project size, options, and demand.
